assessment.nobel_worthiness: Aberration correction transformed electron microscopy into a quantitative atomic-scale instrument and opened otherwise inaccessible materials phenomena to direct observation.
assessment.attribution: Rose supplied decisive electron-optical foundations, while Haider and Urban were central to practical corrected instruments and their experimental realization.
assessment.maturity: The method has been extensively reproduced, commercialized and used across physics and materials science for decades.
uncertainties: The historical boundary between theoretical invention, instrumental engineering and other key developers requires careful archival attribution.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Silicon microstrip and pixel detectors made precision tracking and imaging possible on an extraordinary scale, with broad consequences beyond their original particle-physics setting.
assessment.attribution: The named researchers represent foundational detector concepts and their translation into working hybrid and pixel devices.
assessment.maturity: Their performance is proven by long-term deployment in major experiments and by extensive technological diffusion.
uncertainties: This was a large collaborative instrumentation development, so the precise division of original credit needs scrutiny.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: SASE X-ray free-electron lasers created an entirely new coherent ultrafast X-ray capability, enabling measurements of structural dynamics previously beyond reach.
assessment.attribution: The proposed names cover seminal theoretical and accelerator-physics contributions underlying the SASE concept and its realization.
assessment.maturity: Operational facilities and a large body of transformative experiments demonstrate both technical and scientific maturity.
uncertainties: The lengthy international path from concept to facilities makes individual attribution especially demanding.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The recollision picture supplied a compelling physical mechanism for high-harmonic generation and helped make attosecond science an experimentally productive field.
assessment.attribution: Corkum, Lewenstein and Schafer made closely connected foundational conceptual and quantum-theoretical contributions.
assessment.maturity: High-harmonic and attosecond methods are now experimentally established and repeatedly demonstrate access to electron dynamics.
uncertainties: The relation between the recollision model and credit for the broader experimental attosecond revolution must be delimited carefully.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks combine remarkable precision with a broadly enabling measurement platform for timekeeping, geodesy and fundamental tests.
assessment.attribution: Katori introduced the magic-wavelength lattice-clock concept and Ye made defining contributions to its high-performance realization and development.
assessment.maturity: Independent laboratories have achieved reproducible, exceptional clock performance and important scientific applications.
uncertainties: The eventual practical redefinition and widest societal deployment of optical-clock standards remain incomplete.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The quantum cascade laser was a genuine semiconductor-light-source invention that made tailored mid-infrared and terahertz emission widely usable.
assessment.attribution: Capasso and Faist are central to the invention, with Cho representing essential semiconductor heterostructure foundations.
assessment.maturity: The devices are mature, widely manufactured and consequential in spectroscopy, sensing and communications.
uncertainties: The relative weight of precursor heterostructure inventions versus the original quantum-cascade implementation needs exact historical assessment.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Photonic crystal fibre introduced a highly versatile way to engineer guided light and has enabled distinctive nonlinear, spectral and sensing applications.
assessment.attribution: The three proposed researchers were leading originators of the fibre concepts and early demonstrations.
assessment.maturity: The platform has a long record of replication, technical refinement and scientific use.
uncertainties: Its impact, while substantial, may be less singular and universal than that of the highest-ranked instrument inventions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Room-temperature tunnel magnetoresistance and MgO junctions established a key physical basis for practical spintronic memory and sensing.
assessment.attribution: Moodera and Miyazaki made pivotal experimental advances in tunnel magnetoresistance, while Parkin was central to high-impact spintronic implementation.
assessment.maturity: The effects are thoroughly verified and have had major technological consequences in magnetic storage.
uncertainties: The candidate combines related discoveries and applications whose original contributors may warrant more finely separated attribution.
